title: Smart Thermostat Rebates in Sacramento 2026: $50 from SMUD | HomePowerRebate
desc: SMUD gives a $50 instant rebate on a smart thermostat bought online from the SMUD Energy Store, plus an extra incentive for joining My Energy Optimizer and $30 to recycle a mercury unit.
lead: SMUD gives a $50 instant rebate on a smart thermostat, but only if you buy it online from the SMUD Energy Store. A thermostat bought in a shop does not qualify, which is the one rule people trip over.
cards_intro: These figures come from SMUD's rebates for my home page, which we read on October 2, 2026. SMUD says thermostat rebates are not available in stores.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: An instant rebate when you shop smart thermostats online at the SMUD Energy Store.

cards.title: My Energy Optimizer
cards.note: An additional incentive for joining SMUD's My Energy Optimizer with a qualifying new smart thermostat. SMUD does not state the amount on this page.

cards.title: Mercury thermostat disposal
cards.note: For each old mercury thermostat you drop off through ThermostatCare.

after_cards:
What we could not confirm

SMUD's page promises an additional incentive for My Energy Optimizer but does not list the amount in the part we read, so we do not quote one. Check the program page when you enroll.
sections: The $50 is applied at checkout in the SMUD Energy Store, so there is no mail-in form and no receipt to chase. That is convenient, and it also means a thermostat from a big-box store gets nothing from SMUD. Compare the Energy Store price with the shop price before you decide, since an online-only discount can disappear if the shop is cheaper.
My Energy Optimizer and your rate plan

SMUD describes My Energy Optimizer as a program that protects the grid on very hot days by shifting some of your energy use out of peak hours, and it rewards participants. SMUD also notes that smart thermostats can heat or cool at the times that work best with your rate plan. Before you enroll, check which rate you are on and how the peak hours fall, because the benefit depends on both.

SMUD's instant $50 sits below Burbank's up to $75 (Burbank) and LADWP's Power Savers incentive of up to $145 (Los Angeles). Its advantage is simplicity. Sacramento's average January low over 2015 to 2024 was 4.7°C, and summers are hot, so cooling schedules matter most.
Check that it fits your system

Heat pumps, multi-stage systems and old wall furnaces each have different thermostat needs. Check that the model supports your system and whether your wiring has a common wire. Take a photo of the old wiring before you remove anything. If you are about to buy a heat pump, wait until the contractor picks the unit, because the heat pump may work best with a particular thermostat.
installers_intro: A thermostat is a do-it-yourself job for many homes, but a heat pump or multi-stage system often needs an installer. These Sacramento HVAC companies have the best Google ratings, listed by rating and then review count. We are not paid to list anyone.
claim_heading: How to get the SMUD rebate
claim_steps: Confirm that SMUD is your electric utility.
Shop for a smart thermostat online at the SMUD Energy Store, not in a store.
Check the model supports your heating and cooling system.
If you want the extra incentive, join My Energy Optimizer with the new thermostat.
If you have an old mercury thermostat, drop it off through ThermostatCare for $30.
faq: How much is the SMUD thermostat rebate?
$50 as an instant rebate at the SMUD Energy Store, plus an extra incentive for joining My Energy Optimizer.
Can I buy the thermostat in a store?
No. SMUD says thermostat rebates are not available in stores. Shop online at the SMUD Energy Store.
SMUD pays $30 for each old mercury thermostat you drop off for safe disposal through ThermostatCare.
A SMUD program that rewards you for shifting some energy use out of peak hours, which helps protect the grid on very hot days.
Is there an amount for the My Energy Optimizer incentive?
SMUD's page does not list one in the part we read, so check the program page when you enroll.
